_provenance.title: CROSS-MORSE: Cross-Spectral Control of Message Passing in Frozen Graph Neural Networks
_provenance.transcription_rule: Values are transcribed at the precision printed in the supplied PDFs. They are author-reported measurements, reported derived quantities, or analytical sensitivities as classified in paper/sources.json. They are not new benchmark measurements from the bundled software-validation runs.
_provenance.scope: Curated numerical tables and quantitative claims from the supplied manuscript and supplementary information; not a claim to transcribe every number or raw observation.
_provenance.units: losses in nats (CE or mean multilabel BCE); official metrics in percentage points except where a table states native AP; costs in units of one nominal full-depth execution; GPU-hours on one NVIDIA GH200 96 GB
_provenance.negative_is_better: paired loss effects q_D minus q_C; negative favours the deployed rule
_provenance.source_precedence: The 20-page main manuscript determines the interpretation of main results; supplementary tables retain their printed values and explicit caveats. Sources are identified by PDF SHA-256, not inferred publication status.
_provenance.compatibility_note: paired_CE_change_range_nats is a retained machine key for the reported CE-or-mean-BCE paired-loss range; it is not restricted to CE.

_interpretation_notes.reported_admission: Admission is descriptive for every reported benchmark. Single-graph units are dependent; PascalVOC-SP, COCO-SP and Peptides-func reused validation for confirmation and admission. Their Table S13 values do not instantiate Theorem 2.
_interpretation_notes.confirmation_split_sensitivity: Table S14b holds effects fixed and rescales standard errors; its intervals and label-retention probabilities are analytical sensitivity, not a measured separated-data rerun and not a repair of validation reuse.
_interpretation_notes.registered_selection_audit: The registered epsilon_eq=0.002 upper-limit rule reproduces four of seven reported selections on representative rows. Roman, Pascal and COCO differ. The full executed selector trace is not supplied; a different point-estimate reading matching those rows does not identify that trace.

peptides_score_discrepancy.interpretation: The 0.0002 AP difference exceeds the 0.0001 maximum rounding discrepancy for two scores printed to four decimals. Main Table 1 is retained for the paired estimate. Unrounded per-seed records are not tabulated.

_interpretation_notes.cost_quantities: Expected branch cost, observed maximum (not tabulated), modelled C_0.99 tail quantile, assurance two-branch configuration and Algorithm S3 hard cap are distinct quantities.
_interpretation_notes.configuration_ranges: Tables S45, S46 and S46b report configuration ranges, not paired 95% confidence intervals. S46b does not tabulate arm-level adjusted P values, actual-work observations or budget-mismatch values.
_interpretation_notes.uncertainty_hierarchy: Main test intervals include seed and evaluation-unit resampling; Table S13 admission moments condition on a fixed ensemble. The 93–98% seed-share calculation is a lower bound under the two-way model across different stages, not estimated variance components.
_interpretation_notes.withdrawn_support_summaries: No withdrawn dataset-level ESS/max-weight pair is used as a support measurement. Illustrative ESS values in Table S28 are analytical reference counts only.
